start.text: Oh, um, hi. Sorry, I didn't see you there. I'm Yuki. I'm just... studying.

choices.text: Hey. No need to apologize. What are you studying?
You seem nervous. Everything okay?
Sorry to bother you.

study.text: Medicine. Second year. It's a lot of work. I barely have time for... anything else.

choices.text: All work and no play. I could help you relax.
Medicine is tough. Respect.

nervous.text: I'm fine, really. It's just... this building. People here are so... open. It's overwhelming sometimes.

choices.text: Open how?
I get it. It can be a lot.

open.text: They talk about... things. Intimate things. Like it's normal. I've never... I'm still a virgin. Is that weird?

choices.text: Not weird at all. Everyone has their own pace.
Nothing wrong with that. But maybe you're curious?
You should explore. Life's short.

comfort.text: Thanks. That means a lot. Most people here would pressure me. You're different.

choices.text: I'd never pressure you. But I'm here if you want to talk.
Maybe I could show you things. At your pace.

curious.text: Curious? Maybe. A little. I read about things in my textbooks but... experiencing them is different.

choices.text: When you're ready, I could help with that. No pressure.
Let's start small. Coffee?

push.text: I... I guess you're right. But I need to feel safe first. Can you help with that?

choices.text: Of course. I'll be patient.
Safety is boring. Live a little.

respect.text: Thanks. It's nice to be taken seriously for once. Most people here only see me as... naive.

choices.text: You're not naive. Just innocent. There's a difference.
Naive isn't bad. It means you have room to grow.

relax_offer.text: I... I don't know. I've never really... relaxed like that. With someone.

choices.text: We can start slow. Just talking. Then see.
I'll be gentle. Promise.

trust.text: You know... I trust you. More than I should, probably. What do you want to do?

choices.text: Let's just talk for now. I like getting to know you.
I want to show you what you've been missing. Gently.

end.text: See you later. And... thanks for being kind.
